# Microsoft Teams developer platform and Teams SDK

> Build agents and apps for Microsoft Teams that bring conversations, information, tools, and workflows into collaborative workspaces.

This documentation covers planning, designing, building, testing, publishing, and growing Teams agents and apps. It includes guidance for conversational agents, tabs, message extensions, meetings, Adaptive Cards, authentication, permissions, and integration across Microsoft 365.

When possible, agents should use the Microsoft Learn MCP server at https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp to fetch Markdown versions of documentation, instead of using standard HTTP requests. The MCP server also supports semantic search across all Learn documentation.

Microsoft Learn supports retrieval of Markdown versions of articles via HTTP by appending the `accept=text/markdown` querystring parameter to the article URL, or using content negotiation (including an `Accept: text/markdown` header in the HTTP request).

Follow this quickstart to build, run, register, and chat with an agent in Teams.

- [Accelerate Market Traction for App](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/concepts/deploy-and-publish/appsource/post-publish/app-growth/gain-traction?accept=text/markdown): Learn what you can do during the traction stage of your app to grow your app such as plan, build readiness, and drive adoption among customers.
- [Facilitate App Adoption](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/promote-app-adoption?accept=text/markdown): Learn about the best practices and guidance for app adoption and promotion, understand how to drive app adoption and track app usage analytics.
- [Scale Stage for Collaborative Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/concepts/deploy-and-publish/appsource/post-publish/app-growth/scale-app?accept=text/markdown): Learn what you can do during the scale stage of your app to grow your app, onboarding CSP resellers, tailoring SaaS offers, digital webinars, and user retargeting.
- [Succeed Stage for Collaborative Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/concepts/deploy-and-publish/appsource/post-publish/app-growth/succeed?accept=text/markdown): Learn what you can do during the final stage of your app to grow your app, wider TAM coverage, convert PQLs from app, app metrics and data-backed insights.
- [Monetize your App](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/concepts/deploy-and-publish/appsource/prepare/monetize-overview?accept=text/markdown): Learn about monetizing your app through SaaS offers and other supported options such as free trials, in-app purchases, test drives, and private plans.
- [Create SaaS Offer for Teams App](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/concepts/deploy-and-publish/appsource/prepare/include-saas-offer?accept=text/markdown): Learn how to plan, create, and configure a SaaS offer. Know the basic information on technical requirements, landing page, offer plan, and API integrations.
- [Test Saas Preview Offer for Teams App](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/concepts/deploy-and-publish/appsource/prepare/test-preview-for-monetized-apps?accept=text/markdown): Learn to create and test SaaS preview offers for Teams app. Generate a preview offer ID and configure your app with the preview offer ID to test the offer.
- [Publish SaaS app to Teams Store](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/concepts/deploy-and-publish/appsource/prepare/publish-saas-offer-app?accept=text/markdown): Learn how to configure the SaaS offer to your app and publish the app to the Microsoft Teams Store and how to remove a SaaS offer.
- [In-app Purchases for App Monetization](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/concepts/deploy-and-publish/appsource/prepare/in-app-purchase-flow?accept=text/markdown): Learn the basic tasks and concepts needed to implement in-app purchases such as app manifest update, purchase experience API, and trial functionality in Teams apps.
- [Buy & Manage App Subscription & License](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/concepts/deploy-and-publish/appsource/prepare/end-user-purchase-experience?accept=text/markdown): Learn how to purchase, assign, and manage app subscriptions and licenses for third-party apps in Microsoft Teams and admin purchasing experience.
- [Microsoft 365 app manifest schema reference | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/extensibility/schema?accept=text/markdown): Reference documentation for the Microsoft 365 app manifest schema
- [Teams Agent Events and Activity Handlers](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/bots/agent-activity-handler-reference?accept=text/markdown): Teams agent events include messages, member changes, channel updates, meetings, and card actions. Find handler registration syntax for each SDK language.
- [Microsoft Teams SDK for .NET Reference - Teams | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/teams-sdk-dotnet?accept=text/markdown): Reference documentation for Microsoft Teams SDK for .NET.
- [Microsoft Teams SDK for TypeScript Reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/javascript/api/teams-sdk-typescript?accept=text/markdown): Reference documentation for Microsoft Teams SDK for TypeScript.
- [Microsoft Teams SDK for Python Reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/python/api/msteams-sdk-python?accept=text/markdown): Reference documentation for Microsoft Teams SDK for Python.
- [Microsoft Teams JavaScript client library reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/javascript/api/overview/msteams-client?accept=text/markdown): Reference documentation for JavaScript client libraries for Teams app development
- [Teams Platform Developer Announcements](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/developer-announcements?accept=text/markdown): Learn about new Microsoft Teams developer features and updates to existing features, deprecation notes, and changes. Subscribe to the Atom feed for latest updates.
- [Code Samples](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/get-started/code-samples?accept=text/markdown): Teams app code samples show you how to build agents and apps. Find feature-focused examples for TypeScript, Python, and C# in the official GitHub repos.
- [Support and feedback for Teams developers](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/developer-support-feedback?accept=text/markdown): Report issues, request features, and ask questions about building agents and apps on the Microsoft Teams platform.
- [Teams Preview Features for Agent and App Developers](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/developer-preview-features?accept=text/markdown): Test Teams preview features before general availability. Learn how public preview and the developer preview manifest help you prepare your agents and apps.
- [Teams Developer Documentation - FAQs](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/teams-faq?accept=text/markdown): In this article, check FAQS on Adaptive Card Previewer, bots, Live Share, Microsoft 365 Chat, Teams AI library, Teams SDK, Partner Center, and other Teams FAQs.
- [Teams Developer Documentation Glossary](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/get-started/glossary?accept=text/markdown): Learn about the glossary such as common terms, meanings, and definitions used in Microsoft Teams developer documentation.
- [Deprecated Tools and SDKs for Teams development](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/deprecated-tools-sdks?accept=text/markdown): Deprecated Teams app frameworks like TeamsFx and Bot Framework are no longer supported. Learn about these older tools and plan your migration to current solutions today.
